svg.title: Transition, observation, and assignment — V3
svg.desc: Three execution flows from the supplied reference. Transition: Request, Retrieve, Run, Commit, Response. Observation: Request, Retrieve, Run, Response; Commit is skipped. Assignment: Request, Run, Commit, Response; Retrieve is skipped. Translucent purple, blue, and green fills with diagonal dashed hatching group the active stages. V1 styling with shallow axonometric block depth and slightly heavier arrows. Block labels use Geist Sans; row and legend labels use Geist Mono. All labels are converted to vector paths for portable rendering. Static SVG; no scripts or external resources.
